newsitem.title: USA: Raytheon unit wins $13.6 mln contract. [CORRECTED 19:25 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Raytheon unit wins $13.6 mln contract. [CORRECTED 19:25 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects value of contract in headline and text from $31.6 mln)
Raytheon TI Systems Inc said Monday it had received a $13.6 million contract for engineering and manufacturing development for the long-range advanced scount surveillance system, or LRAS3.
The Raytheon Co unit said the contract was awarded by the Communications-Electronic Sensors Command based in Fort Monmouth, N.J.
A separate LRAS3 contract has been awarded to Hughes Aircraft Co, a unit of Hughes Electronics Corp, it said. It will work in parallel with the Hughes unit to develop the program, it said.
The engineering and manufacturing development phase of the contract is 18 months, with the first prototypes deliverable in 12 months, it said.
Raytheon TI Systems was formerly Texas Instruments Inc's defense systems and electronics business, which Raytheon acquired for $2.95 billion in a deal completed early this month.
